title: Customer Reactivation Campaign Strategies That Gets Lost Customers Back

facts.fact: The page states that reactivating a lapsed customer costs 5–7 times less than acquiring an equivalent new customer, with no source cited.
facts.quote: Reactivating a lapsed customer costs 5–7x less than acquiring an equivalent new customer

facts.fact: The page cites a third-party source (opensend.com) for the claim that existing customers contribute 65% of total revenue for most businesses.
facts.quote: existing customers contribute 65% of total revenue

facts.fact: The page's key takeaways state that a 4–5 touch multi-channel sequence (email, LinkedIn, and SDR) consistently outperforms single-channel reactivation attempts, a claim the page does not back with a cited figure.
facts.quote: A 4–5 touch multi-channel sequence (email + LinkedIn + SDR) consistently outperforms single-channel reactivation attempts.

facts.fact: The page defines the real success metric for reactivation as whether a customer is still active 90 days after reactivation, rather than whether they clicked.
facts.quote: whether they're still active 90 days after reactivation

facts.fact: The page is dated May 26, 2026 and was last modified on the same date.
